title: The Twelve Tribes of Israel
lead: The descendants of Jacob's twelve sons (Genesis 29–30; 35:22–26; 49), with Joseph's two sons Ephraim and Manasseh counted as tribes and Levi set apart for the priesthood. The lists vary across the Bible. The tribes shape Israel's camp, land and history, Jesus' choice of twelve apostles, and Revelation's 144,000 and twelve gates.
